name: arcus
description: ARCUS is a fitness app for people who want to get stronger without making training feel complicated. It helps you plan workouts, log your sets, and see your progress over time, so you can spend less time figuring things out and more time showing up.

paragraphs: ARCUS is a local-first training log. The app uses an IndexedDB-backed workout logger for offline entry and Portways PostgreSQL over serverless WebSockets for account, workout, and library sync. Active drafts remain on the current device until completion. Multi-factor authentication uses encrypted TOTP secrets and one-time hashed recovery codes. Password reset email delivery requires a configured Resend API key and verified sender.
